text: The station's automated distress relay has read OFFLINE on the panel for years; the operators treat it as ordinary.
The relay cable was severed deliberately, by hand — a clean cut, not a failure.
The approach chart mis-marks the reef by half a cable; a relay-guided run onto that bearing puts a ship on the rocks.
A hand-corrected tide table hangs beside the relay panel, annotated in a previous operator's writing.
A district inspection of the station falls due within the week.
